submission.natural_language_explanation: L2/H7 is a retrospective local head: it attends over the previous one to four tokens (chiefly two back, with previous-token score 0.26 and duplicate/induction scores 0.00) and its write to the residual departs from its mean output only where that window is filled with word-internal subword fragments rather than space-initial whole words. On 273k tokens of the scan corpus 19% of word-internal fragment positions are active against 4% of space-initial ones (Indic 50%, Hebrew 46%, Thai 44%, Arabic 39%, Greek 37%, Cyrillic 30% of fragment positions), and activity climbs monotonically with the length of a fragment run (2 hex chunks 0.70, 3 chunks 1.15, 4 chunks 1.38, 6 chunks 2.04 of max), so it fires inside long numbers, hashes, DOIs, versions, IPs and identifier pieces and in densely fused non-Latin script, while ordinary English prose, a single number, date or rare word inside a sentence, whole-word English tokens and sequences of unrelated tokens stay inactive.
